tours.description: Step-by-step guide for a new finance user on the Reconcile button in the Accounting menu: opening Accounting > Actions > Reconcile, reading the Unreconciled list, selecting the two opposite lines of one account and partner, and clicking Reconcile. Worked example: customer Engineer - Production, invoice Sales/2026 against payment PBNK1/2026/00001 in account 121000 Account Receivable.

steps.title: Open the Accounting menu
steps.content: Click the Accounting menu in the top bar. Every accounting action lives here, including the Reconcile tool we are about to use.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Accounting menu in the top bar. Every accounting action lives here, including the Reconcile tool we are about to use.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the Accounting menu in the top bar. Every accounting action lives here, including the Reconcile tool we are about to use.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click the Accounting menu in the top bar. Every accounting action lives here, including the Reconcile tool we are about to use.

steps.title: Click Reconcile under Actions
steps.content: Scroll down the menu to the Actions group and click Reconcile. This opens the list of journal items that are still waiting to be matched.

content_i18n.en_US: Scroll down the menu to the Actions group and click Reconcile. This opens the list of journal items that are still waiting to be matched.
content_i18n.si_LK: Scroll down the menu to the Actions group and click Reconcile. This opens the list of journal items that are still waiting to be matched.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Scroll down the menu to the Actions group and click Reconcile. This opens the list of journal items that are still waiting to be matched.

steps.title: Check the Unreconciled filter
steps.content: The screen opens with the Unreconciled filter already applied and the lines grouped by Account, then Partner. Only journal items still waiting to be matched are listed here.

content_i18n.en_US: The screen opens with the Unreconciled filter already applied and the lines grouped by Account, then Partner. Only journal items still waiting to be matched are listed here.
content_i18n.si_LK: The screen opens with the Unreconciled filter already applied and the lines grouped by Account, then Partner. Only journal items still waiting to be matched are listed here.
content_i18n.ta_IN: The screen opens with the Unreconciled filter already applied and the lines grouped by Account, then Partner. Only journal items still waiting to be matched are listed here.

steps.title: Expand the customer group
steps.content: Find the account you need to match - here 121000 Account Receivable, holding 1.00 debit (the invoice) and 1.00 credit (the payment). Click the partner line Engineer - Production under it to open the individual journal items. Always reconcile within one account and one partner.

content_i18n.en_US: Find the account you need to match - here 121000 Account Receivable, holding 1.00 debit (the invoice) and 1.00 credit (the payment). Click the partner line Engineer - Production under it to open the individual journal items. Always reconcile within one account and one partner.

steps.title: Select the payment line
steps.content: Tick the checkbox on the payment line PBNK1/2026/00001 - the 1.00 credit received from the customer.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the checkbox on the payment line PBNK1/2026/00001 - the 1.00 credit received from the customer.
content_i18n.si_LK: Tick the checkbox on the payment line PBNK1/2026/00001 - the 1.00 credit received from the customer.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Tick the checkbox on the payment line PBNK1/2026/00001 - the 1.00 credit received from the customer.

steps.title: Select the invoice line
steps.content: Now tick the customer invoice line Sales/2026 - the 1.00 debit. Debit and credit must add up to zero for a full match; if they do not, Odoo keeps the difference open as a partial reconciliation.

content_i18n.en_US: Now tick the customer invoice line Sales/2026 - the 1.00 debit. Debit and credit must add up to zero for a full match; if they do not, Odoo keeps the difference open as a partial reconciliation.

steps.title: Click the Reconcile button
steps.content: With both lines ticked, click Reconcile. Odoo matches them, drops the residual to zero, gives them a Matching number and marks the invoice as paid.

content_i18n.en_US: With both lines ticked, click Reconcile. Odoo matches them, drops the residual to zero, gives them a Matching number and marks the invoice as paid.

steps.title: Confirm the lines are matched
steps.content: 121000 Account Receivable now shows (0) with a zero balance - both lines have left the unreconciled list, which means the match worked.

content_i18n.en_US: 121000 Account Receivable now shows (0) with a zero balance - both lines have left the unreconciled list, which means the match worked.

steps.title: Remove the Unreconciled filter
steps.content: Click the x on the Unreconciled filter. The matched invoice and payment do not come back into this list - this screen only ever shows items still waiting to be matched, so an account that has disappeared from here is fully reconciled. To see the Matching number itself, open Accounting > Journal Items.
